clue.text: Skates backwards in a classy arabesque

in says the letters sit within the words classy arabesque

explanation.walkthrough: 'in' finds SYAR across classy arabesque, and 'backwards' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Skates are flat fish, and rays are their close relatives; the names are used for the same fish.

indicators.note: led astray means wandering off course, so the letters of set led go out of order

explanation.surface: The oldest group were misguided by their leaders.

explanation.definitionFit: To have secured something is to have obtained it.

parts.note: the ant is proverbially industrious
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A hard-working employee has joined the opposing side.
explanation.definitionFit: Being against something puts you on the opposing side.

definitions.meaning: far away in space or time

explanation.surface: A far-off place that is freezing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something far off is remote, and a person who is aloof and unwelcoming is cold in manner.

clue.text: A westerner losing nothing by chance

indicators.note: losing means the following item is dropped from the phrase

explanation.surface: A Western traveller lost everything through mere bad luck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing' drops the O from A OCCIDENTAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that happens unplanned and unintended occurs through luck.

clue.text: Making a minister sob as drama unfolds

explanation.surface: A government official breaks down in tears as a play reaches its climax.
explanation.definitionFit: An envoy representing a state abroad is a diplomatic minister of top rank.

clue.text: The worst element can always rise to the top

definitions.text: The worst element can always rise to the top

parts.words: The worst element can always rise to the top
parts.note: reads as a cynical comment on careers, but describes the froth of impurities floating on liquid, also the dregs of society

explanation.surface: A cynical comment that the worst people always get promoted.
explanation.definitionFit: The film of dirt on a liquid floats up, and the word also means the lowest kind of people.

clue.text: Deny cast is involved in commercial associations

parts.note: a vehicle from Russia whose engine is literally plenty of horses, three abreast

explanation.surface: A Russian car with a powerful engine.

parts.note: looks like a tidy burglar, but neat is an old word for cattle, so this is a cattle thief

explanation.surface: A tidy burglar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'neat' here means cattle, an archaic usage loved by setters.
explanation.definitionFit: A cattle thief steals livestock from a ranch.

clue.text: Set a new price for crop-with approval

parts.note: to crop is to cut or harvest, to reap
praise is expressed approval

explanation.surface: A farmer revalues the harvest after it wins acclaim.
explanation.definitionFit: To value something again is to make a fresh assessment of its worth.

port is the left-hand side of a ship

explanation.surface: A political jibe that one person is wrecking the left-wing cause.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Left' looks political, but it is the nautical side.

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery, the British army's gunners
to bat is to strike, as with a bat

explanation.surface: Armed men attack a North African city.
explanation.definitionFit: The seat of government of Morocco is this Atlantic coast city.

parts.note: sounds like someone with no ambition, but describes having no aim, aim also meaning purpose or end

a drug or measure acts when it produces an effect

explanation.definitionFit: To pass a law is to decree it.

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number
an aunt is a family relative

explanation.definitionFit: To intimidate someone so they lose courage.

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, and the 's adds an S

definitions.meaning: a raised knob or ornamental nail
a farm where horses are kept for breeding

parts.note: to clear out is to flee, to run

clue.text: Some sailor put up on a bicycle

parts.note: part means some of
a tar is a sailor

indicators.note: sound tells us the word for jolly is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: jolly means funny, amusing

explanation.surface: A cheerful exclamation about a healthy bone.

clue.text: The wrong place to find a wild animal

indicators.note: wrong means not right, so the letters of place to are in the wrong order

explanation.surface: Somewhere one would never expect to meet a wild creature.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark-furred member of the weasel family known for its smell.

clue.text: Gymnastic performer taking a big drink

definitions.meaning: a tall flat-bottomed glass, or its contents

explanation.surface: A gymnast enjoying a large glass of something.
explanation.definitionFit: An acrobat who turns somersaults, and a straight-sided drinking glass.

clue.text: Being upset over direction, can be generous

explanation.definitionFit: Appearance or outward expression, as in a cheerful look.

explanation.surface: Yearning for a settlement.

clue.text: Urgently read overlapping newspapers one by one!
